blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Protesters responsible for setting fire to an effigy during the November 16, 2026, walkout rally in Cebu City may soon face criminal charges as police authorities intensify efforts to establish their identities. Police Regional Office 7 (PRO 7) spokesperson Police Lieutenant Colonel Rolan Aliser confirmed that investigators from the Cebu City Police Office (CCPO) are actively reviewing available evidence to pinpoint the exact individuals who initiated and participated in the burning. While no specific suspects have been formally named as of press time, Aliser stressed that the investigation remains an active priority for local law enforcement. READ: Archival […]...
